# Second independent hardening gap fixtures

The author read only public contract/model/test helpers, including the full walker contract, and did not read either reviewer implementation. No expected semantic output was obtained by executing a decoder, finder, resolver, reconciler, walker or reviewer. Existing helpers construct coherent input sources; expected errors, action order, waiting, support and held-answer values are literal public-contract consequences. Root owns formatting, execution and wrong-variant classification.

| New test | Authority and independent oracle |
| -- | -- |
| TestGapBeginComparesEveryWarningAndArrangementChannel | Reviewer Begin and equality compare complete re-derived Proposal content, including Review.PreparationProblems, IncomingWarnings, EffectivePlanWarnings and Support.Arrangements. Each baseline channel is empty. Adding one concrete cached diagnostic or arrangement without changing Evidence must yield only invitation.proposal, Stage begin.proposal, path proposal, with zero Publication. Both a valid event and an invalid event pin consistency refusal before event interpretation. A fresh-instance unchanged positive still requires the existing literal begun.record.yaml. |
| TestGapWalkerPreservesWaitingAndEscalationOnEveryActivity | Actual walker contract requires global prerequisite order, direct unverified Requires targets in WaitingOn, and rendered escalation on every row, not only after failure. Literal declaration order deploy/access with deploy Requires access must produce access/deploy. Empty identity seed has no verified access outcome, so deploy waits on access while access waits on nothing. Exact local contact references resolve through the real directory rules to Support, #help; repeated deploy escalation remains repeated, and held Section.Escalation remains $helper. The ready access row also receives support. Held organizational answers remain contact ID helper; no support/prerequisite fact creates a record answer, outcome, or completion. No new hash golden is asserted. |

Proposed wrong-implementation table additions: omit any of the four cached channels from Begin equality; discard actual Walker.WaitingOn; discard rendered Walker.Escalation or restrict it to failed/waiting rows. Existing tests/fixtures are unchanged. No passing or accepted-survivor claim is made by this author.
